name: Deep vs Surface Scratches: Which Need a Full Refinish
title-tag: Deep vs Surface Scratches: Recoat or Full Refinish?
meta-description: A fingernail test tells you if a scratched hardwood floor needs a $1.99/sq ft recoat or a full refinish. A Seattle-area contractor explains the line.
post-summary: October 2, 2026 · Scratches in the finish buff out with a $1.99/sq ft screen & recoat; scratches into the wood need a full sand. A fingernail and a drop of water tell you which you have — and waiting too long turns the cheap fix into the expensive one.
